runtime.name: Dungeon entrance and Kua-tin threshold
runtime.description: Broad carved descent to a marble landing and enormous arched Kua-tin doors. Beyond them, the first-floor route begins; exact chamber dimensions are unknown.

runtime.name: False Tutorial Guild alley
runtime.description: A misleading neon guild sign leads into the goblin Murder Dozer ambush. The alley and trap are one encounter sequence, not two separate destinations.

runtime.name: Mordecai’s Tutorial Guildhall
runtime.description: The real Tutorial Guild entrance opens to Mordecai’s personal tutorial space, with a classroom and living area. Mordecai is a guide and NPC here, not a deployable party member.

runtime.name: Hoarder’s lair / Scatterer nest
runtime.description: A round, high-ceiling room among rubbish piles and burst bags, with a grimy signed door and skull torches. The Scatterer territory belongs to this lair complex.

runtime.name: Tally’s Polish restaurant safe room
runtime.description: A Polish fast-food restaurant repurposed as a protected safe room. The children’s play area is inside this same venue. Exact chain branding and layout are not established.

nodes.label: Goblin workshop and adjoining boss chamber

runtime.name: Goblin workshop and adjoining boss chamber
runtime.description: A goblin engineering and explosives workshop connected to the War Chieftain’s chamber. Workshop equipment is an adaptation of its stated use; exact machinery and room plan are not canonical.

runtime.name: DMV waiting-room safe room
runtime.description: An Earth DMV waiting room used as a safe room, with curtained cots and an experience-cookie encounter associated with Frank and Maggie.

runtime.name: Juicer’s gym
runtime.description: A high-ceiling gym with sliding glass entry, reception turnstile, weights, benches and mats. Red combat lighting is part of the encounter presentation.

nodes.label: Sebastian’s Peruvian Taco Bell safe room

runtime.name: Sebastian’s Peruvian Taco Bell safe room
runtime.description: A converted restaurant safe room with kitchen, sleeping area, bathrooms, coffee, and Peruvian beer. Exact room layout is not established.

runtime.name: Meadow Lark encampment
runtime.description: A survivor encampment near the borough-boss stairwell. Treat its footprint as an authored camp layout; sources establish the camp and proximity, not a canonical settlement plan.

nodes.label: Ball of Swine spiral maze and stairwell

runtime.name: Ball of Swine spiral maze and stairwell
runtime.description: Rounded tunnels spiral around a courtyard, with portcullises and three bridge approaches. The final boss encounter reveals the arena and its stairwell. The switch chamber and Speedbump construction area are subregions/states, not separate destinations.

runtime.name: Abandoned service store
runtime.description: An adapted service store with sealed emergency supplies, beyond the borough boss approach.
